```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// PUBLICATION-LAYER CONTRACT
// --------------------------
// This dashboard reads only files produced by mortality Step 6 and mirrored under
// site/downloads/. It does not classify deaths, calculate percentages, calculate
// rolling comparators, apply disclosure control, or reconstruct protected values.
//
// Two deliberately permitted presentation-derived statistics are used here:
//
// 1. YTD count is the sum of complete, published monthly counts from January to the
//    selected month. It is shown only when every contributing month is present, complete,
//    unsuppressed and numeric. Otherwise YTD is unavailable.
// 2. Possible-only deaths is the difference between the published Inclusive and Primary
//    annual counts for the same year and CVD type. For comparability across All CVD, Heart
//    and Stroke, the quality matrix standardises this difference as a percentage of the
//    Inclusive annual count. It is shown only when both source counts are present, complete,
//    unsuppressed and numeric.
//
// Neither statistic is an independently released BNR metric and neither is written back
// to a dataset.
//
// The fixed 2015-2019 monthly reference asset is loaded exactly as published. The
// dashboard never recalculates that reference asset.
burden = FileAttachment("../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv").csv({typed: true})
monthly_reference = FileAttachment("../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Editable display labels and colours are defined as simple functions.
// Keeping these as named OJS function cells avoids object-literal cell ambiguity
// while leaving all human-facing wording and colours in one obvious place.
definitionLabel = d => ({
  primary_clear_likely: "Primary",
  upper_clear_likely_possible: "Inclusive"
})[d] || d

definitionDetail = d => ({
  primary_clear_likely: "clear + likely",
  upper_clear_likely_possible: "clear + likely + possible"
})[d] || d

eventLabel = d => ({all_cvd: "All CVD", heart: "Heart", stroke: "Stroke"})[d] || d
sexLabel = d => ({all: "All", female: "Women", male: "Men"})[d] || d
ageLabel = d => ({all: "All ages", under_70: "Under 70", age_70_plus: "70 and older"})[d] || d

colour = key => ({
  primary: "#045174",
  inclusive: "#6F5AA8",
  comparator: "rgba(232,122,0,.55)",
  referenceBand: "rgba(232,122,0,.18)",
  referenceMean: "rgba(232,122,0,.78)",
  heart: "#D46A6A",
  stroke: "#6E8FB3",
  under70: "#D89C60",
  older70: "#7A8794",
  women: "#C07A8E",
  men: "#5E8791"
})[key]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Release identity comes from the current dataset. The catalogue filename uses the
// same release ID, allowing future releases to replace current.csv without editing
// this QMD.
release_id = burden.length ? burden[0].release_id : ""
release_catalogue_url = release_id
  ? `../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/catalogue/${release_id}.yml`
  : ""
release_catalogue_text = release_catalogue_url
  ? fetch(release_catalogue_url).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : "").catch(() => "")
  : Promise.resolve("")
release_date_raw = (() => {
  const match = release_catalogue_text.match(/^release_date:\s*([^\r\n#]+)/m)
  return match ? match[1].trim().replace(/^['\"]|['\"]$/g, "") : ""
})()
release_date_label = (() => {
  if (!release_date_raw) return "Not stated"
  const dt = new Date(`${release_date_raw}T00:00:00`)
  return Number.isNaN(dt.getTime())
    ? release_date_raw
    : dt.toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {day: "numeric", month: "short", year: "numeric"})
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_indicator = Inputs.select(
  ["counts", "profile", "rates"],
  {
    label: "Indicator",
    value: "counts",
    format: d => ({counts: "Number of deaths", profile: "Distribution of deaths", rates: "Mortality rate"}[d])
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_case_definitions = (() => {
  const input = Inputs.checkbox(
    ["primary_clear_likely", "upper_clear_likely_possible"],
    {
      label: "Mortality definition",
      value: ["primary_clear_likely"],
      format: d => definitionLabel(d)
    }
  )

  // Quarto preview can retain the previous checkbox DOM state during hot reloads.
  // Ensure the first construction of this control visibly starts on Primary,
  // which is the intended default dashboard definition.
  const boxes = input.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')
  if (boxes.length && !Array.from(boxes).some(box => box.checked)) {
    boxes[0].checked = true
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  }
  return input
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_period_type = (() => {
  if (selected_indicator === "profile") {
    const wrapper = html`<div>
      <label>Time period</label>
      <div class="bnr-period-fixed">Annual</div>
    </div>`
    wrapper.value = "annual"
    return wrapper
  }
  if (selected_indicator === "rates") {
    const wrapper = html`<div>
      <label>Time period</label>
      <div class="bnr-period-fixed">Annual</div>
    </div>`
    wrapper.value = "annual"
    return wrapper
  }
  return Inputs.select(
    ["monthly", "quarterly", "annual"],
    {label: "Time period", value: "quarterly", format: d => d[0].toUpperCase() + d.slice(1)}
  )
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Event options are derived from the published rows. This makes the control expand
// automatically if later approved releases extend the time horizon, while preserving
// the deliberately restricted monthly scope.
effective_period_type = ["profile", "rates"].includes(selected_indicator) ? "annual" : selected_period_type
effective_metric_id = selected_indicator === "counts" ? "MORT-BURDEN-001" : selected_indicator === "rates" ? "MORT-RATE-001" : "MORT-BURDEN-002"
event_order = ["all_cvd", "heart", "stroke"]
event_options = Array.from(new Set(
  burden
    .filter(d => d.metric_id === effective_metric_id && d.period_type === effective_period_type)
    .map(d => d.event_type)
)).sort((a, b) => event_order.indexOf(a) - event_order.indexOf(b))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_event_type = Inputs.select(

)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_rate_sexes = (() => {
  if (selected_indicator !== "rates") {
    const wrapper = html`<div style="display:none"></div>`
    wrapper.value = ["all"]
    return wrapper
  }
  const input = Inputs.checkbox(
    ["all", "female", "male"],
    {
      label: "Sex",
      value: ["all"],
      format: d => ({all: "Both sexes", female: "Women", male: "Men"}[d])
    }
  )
  const boxes = input.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')
  if (boxes.length) {
    const optionLabels = Array.from(boxes).map(box => box.closest("label")).filter(Boolean)
    const optionContainer = optionLabels[0]?.parentElement
    if (optionContainer) {
      optionContainer.style.display = "flex"
      optionContainer.style.flexDirection = "column"
      optionContainer.style.alignItems = "flex-start"
      optionContainer.style.gap = ".2rem"
    }
    optionLabels.forEach(label => {
      label.style.display = "flex"
      label.style.alignItems = "center"
      label.style.justifyContent = "flex-start"
      label.style.width = "100%"
      label.style.margin = "0"
    })
  }
  if (boxes.length && !Array.from(boxes).some(box => box.checked)) {
    boxes[0].checked = true
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  }
  return input
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_count_sexes = (() => {
  const selectableCountSex =
    selected_indicator === "counts" &&
    ["quarterly", "annual"].includes(selected_period_type)

  if (!selectableCountSex) {
    // Rates have their own selectable Sex control immediately above this cell.
    // Every other view is fixed to the combined population, so retain the
    // control in the usual position as a checked, disabled Both sexes box.
    if (selected_indicator === "rates") {
      const wrapper = html`<div style="display:none"></div>`
      wrapper.value = ["all"]
      return wrapper
    }

    const input = Inputs.checkbox(
      ["all"],
      {label: "Sex", value: ["all"], format: () => "Both sexes"}
    )
    const box = input.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]')
    if (box) {
      box.checked = true
      box.disabled = true
      const label = box.closest("label")
      if (label) {
        label.style.opacity = "0.48"
        label.style.cursor = "default"
        label.title = "Only Both sexes is available for this view."
      }
    }
    return input
  }

  const input = Inputs.checkbox(
    ["all", "female", "male"],
    {
      label: "Sex",
      value: ["all"],
      format: d => ({all: "Both sexes", female: "Women", male: "Men"})[d]
    }
  )
  const boxes = input.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')
  if (boxes.length) {
    const optionLabels = Array.from(boxes).map(box => box.closest("label")).filter(Boolean)
    const optionContainer = optionLabels[0]?.parentElement
    if (optionContainer) {
      optionContainer.style.display = "flex"
      optionContainer.style.flexDirection = "column"
      optionContainer.style.alignItems = "flex-start"
      optionContainer.style.gap = ".2rem"
    }
    optionLabels.forEach(label => {
      label.style.display = "flex"
      label.style.alignItems = "center"
      label.style.justifyContent = "flex-start"
      label.style.width = "100%"
      label.style.margin = "0"
    })
  }
  if (boxes.length && !Array.from(boxes).some(box => box.checked)) {
    boxes[0].checked = true
    input.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  }
  return input
})()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected_age_groups = (() => {
  const activeCountSexesForAge = Array.isArray(selected_count_sexes) ? selected_count_sexes : ["all"]
  const bothSexesOnly =
    activeCountSexesForAge.length === 1 &&
    activeCountSexesForAge[0] === "all"
  const ageBreakdownAvailable =
    selected_indicator === "counts" &&
    selected_period_type === "annual" &&
    selected_event_type === "all_cvd" &&
    bothSexesOnly

  if (ageBreakdownAvailable) {
    const ageOrder = ["all", "under_70", "age_70_plus"]
    const options = Array.from(new Set(
      burden
        .filter(d =>
          d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
          d.period_type === "annual" &&
          d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
          d.statistic === "annual_count"
        )
        .map(d => d.age_group)
    )).sort((a, b) => ageOrder.indexOf(a) - ageOrder.indexOf(b))

    const input = Inputs.checkbox(
      options,
      {label: "Age group", value: ["all"], format: d => ageLabel(d)}
    )
    const boxes = input.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]')
    if (boxes.length) {
      const optionLabels = Array.from(boxes).map(box => box.closest("label")).filter(Boolean)
      const optionContainer = optionLabels[0]?.parentElement
      if (optionContainer) {
        optionContainer.style.display = "flex"
        optionContainer.style.flexDirection = "column"
        optionContainer.style.alignItems = "flex-start"
        optionContainer.style.gap = ".2rem"
      }
      optionLabels.forEach(label => {
        label.style.display = "flex"
        label.style.alignItems = "center"
        label.style.justifyContent = "flex-start"
        label.style.width = "100%"
        label.style.margin = "0"
      })
    }
    return input
  }

  const input = Inputs.checkbox(
    ["all"],
    {label: "Age group", value: ["all"], format: () => "All ages"}
  )
  const box = input.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]')
  if (box) {
    box.checked = true
    box.disabled = true
    const label = box.closest("label")
    if (label) {
      label.style.opacity = "0.48"
      label.style.cursor = "default"
      label.title =
        selected_indicator === "counts" &&
        selected_period_type === "annual" &&
        selected_event_type === "all_cvd" &&
        !bothSexesOnly
          ? "Age-group breakdowns are available only when Both sexes is the sole selected sex."
          : "Only All ages is available for this view."
    }
  }
  return input
})()
```

```{ojs}
period_control_rows = burden.filter(d =>
  d.metric_id === effective_metric_id &&
  d.period_type === effective_period_type
)
period_control_label = d => {
  if (effective_period_type === "monthly") {
    return new Date(d.period_year, d.period_month - 1, 1).toLocaleString("en-GB", {month: "short", year: "numeric"})
  }
  if (effective_period_type === "quarterly") return `Q${d.period_quarter} ${d.period_year}`
  return String(d.period_year)
}
available_periods = Array.from(
  new Map(
    period_control_rows.map(d => [
      d.period,
      {key: d.period, label: period_control_label(d), sort_value: new Date(d.period_start).getTime()}
    ])
  ).values()
).sort((a, b) => a.sort_value - b.sort_value)
max_period_index = Math.max(0, available_periods.length - 1)
start_period_label = effective_period_type === "monthly" ? "Start month" : effective_period_type === "quarterly" ? "Start quarter" : "Start year"
end_period_label = effective_period_type === "monthly" ? "End month" : effective_period_type === "quarterly" ? "End quarter" : "End year"
periodSlider = (extent, options) => {
  const control = Inputs.range(extent, {label: options.label, step: 1, value: options.value})
  const numberInput = control.querySelector('input[type="number"]')
  if (numberInput) numberInput.style.display = "none"
  const displayValue = html`<div class="bnr-period-slider-value"></div>`
  const updateDisplay = () => { displayValue.textContent = options.format(Math.round(control.value)) }
  control.append(displayValue)
  control.addEventListener("input", updateDisplay)
  updateDisplay()
  return control
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Shared helpers. Suppression is never recalculated here. A numeric value is usable
// only when the published disclosure status says it is not protected.
isComplete = d => d && (d.period_complete === 1 || d.period_complete === "1" || d.period_complete === true)
isSafe = d => d && d.suppression_status === "none" && Number.isFinite(d.value)
hasPublishedValue = d => isSafe(d) && d.status_flag !== "insufficient_history"
periodLabel = d => {
  if (!d) return "—"
  if (d.period_type === "monthly") return new Date(d.period_year, d.period_month - 1, 1).toLocaleString("en-GB", {month: "short", year: "numeric"})
  if (d.period_type === "quarterly") return `Q${d.period_quarter} ${d.period_year}`
  return String(d.period_year)
}
formatValue = d => {
  if (!d) return "—"
  if (!isSafe(d)) return d.display_value || "—"
  return d.unit === "percent" ? `${d.value.toFixed(1)}%` : Math.round(d.value).toLocaleString()
}
rateStatistic = d => d === "asr" ? "annual_age_standardised_rate" : "annual_crude_rate"
rateAgeGroup = d => d === "asr" ? "age_standardised" : "all"
rateSexLabel = d => ({all: "Both sexes", female: "Women", male: "Men"}[d] || d)
rateSexDash = d => ({all: null, female: "8,5", male: "2,4"}[d] ?? null)
rateSexLegendStyle = d => d === "female" ? "dashed" : d === "male" ? "dotted" : "solid"
rateValue = d => {
  if (!d) return "—"
  if (!isSafe(d)) return d.display_value || "—"
  return Number(d.value).toFixed(1)
}
rateInterval = d => {
  if (!d || !isSafe(d)) return d?.display_value || "—"
  return Number.isFinite(d.ci_lower_value) && Number.isFinite(d.ci_upper_value)
    ? `${Number(d.ci_lower_value).toFixed(1)}–${Number(d.ci_upper_value).toFixed(1)}` : "—"
}
ciMethodLabel = d => ({poisson_exact_garwood: "Exact Poisson / Garwood", fay_feuer_gamma: "Fay–Feuer gamma"}[d] || d || "—")
plotDownloadBase = value => String(value || "bnr-mortality-plot").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "bnr-mortality-plot"
plotSvgNode = plot => plot?.tagName?.toLowerCase() === "svg" ? plot : plot?.querySelector?.("svg")
plotSvgText = plot => {
  const svg = plotSvgNode(plot)
  if (!svg) return ""
  const clone = svg.cloneNode(true)
  clone.setAttribute("xmlns", "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg")
  clone.setAttribute("xmlns:xlink", "http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink")
  const background = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect")
  background.setAttribute("width", "100%"); background.setAttribute("height", "100%"); background.setAttribute("fill", "white")
  clone.insertBefore(background, clone.firstChild)
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n${new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clone)}`
}
downloadPlot = (plot, baseName) => {
  const svg = plotSvgNode(plot), text = plotSvgText(plot)
  if (!svg || !text) return html``
  const save = (blob, name) => { const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.append(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0) }
  const root = document.createElement("div"); root.className = "bnr-plot-downloads"
  for (const ext of ["svg", "png"]) {
    const button = document.createElement("button"); button.type = "button"; button.className = "bnr-plot-download-button"; button.textContent = `Download ${ext.toUpperCase()}`
    button.onclick = () => {
      if (ext === "svg") return save(new Blob([text], {type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}), `${plotDownloadBase(baseName)}.svg`)
      const image = new Image(), url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([text], {type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}))
      image.onload = () => { const w = Number(svg.getAttribute("width")) || 960, h = Number(svg.getAttribute("height")) || 500, canvas = document.createElement("canvas"); canvas.width = w * 2; canvas.height = h * 2; const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d"); ctx.scale(2, 2); ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, w, h); canvas.toBlob(blob => { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); if (blob) save(blob, `${plotDownloadBase(baseName)}.png`) }, "image/png") }
      image.onerror = () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url); image.src = url
    }
    root.append(button)
  }
  return root
}
formatNumber = x => Number.isFinite(x) ? Math.round(x).toLocaleString() : "—"
sortedRows = rows => [...rows].sort((a, b) => new Date(a.period_start) - new Date(b.period_start))
latestRow = rows => {
  const s = sortedRows(rows)
  return s.length ? s[s.length - 1] : null
}
dateValue = d => d.period_type === "annual" ? d.period_year : new Date(d.period_start)
headline = (label, value, note = "") => html`<div class="bnr-headline-card">
  <div class="bnr-headline-label">${label}</div>
  <div class="bnr-headline-value">${value}</div>
  <div class="bnr-headline-note">${note}</div>
</div>`
headlineByDefinition = (label, items) => {
  if (items.length === 1) return headline(label, items[0].value, items[0].note)
  const notes = Array.from(new Set(items.map(item => item.note).filter(Boolean)))
  const commonNote = notes.length === 1 ? notes[0] : ""
  return html`<div class="bnr-headline-card">
    <div class="bnr-headline-label">${label}</div>
    <div class="bnr-definition-values">
      ${items.map(item => html`<div class="bnr-definition-value-row">
        <div class="bnr-definition-value-name" style=${`color:${definitionColour(item.definition)}`}>${definitionLabel(item.definition)}</div>
        <div class="bnr-definition-value-number">${item.value}</div>
        ${commonNote ? "" : html`<div class="bnr-definition-value-note">${item.note}</div>`}
      </div>`)}
    </div>
    ${commonNote ? html`<div class="bnr-headline-note">${commonNote}</div>` : ""}
  </div>`
}
interpretation = (title, what, use) => html`<div class="bnr-interpretation">
  <div class="bnr-interpretation-title">${title}</div>
  <div class="bnr-interpretation-grid">
    <div class="bnr-interpretation-label">What this shows</div><div>${what}</div>
    <div class="bnr-interpretation-label">How to read it</div><div>${use} <a href="../../../../methods/measures/mortality.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Public Methods: mortality</a>.</div>
  </div>
</div>`
definitionColour = d => d === "primary_clear_likely" ? colour("primary") : colour("inclusive")
definitionSelection = definitions => html`<div class="bnr-definition-choice">
  ${definitions.map((d, i) => html`${i ? html`<span class="bnr-definition-join">&nbsp;and&nbsp;</span>` : ""}<strong style=${`color:${definitionColour(d)}`}>${definitionLabel(d)}</strong>`)}
</div>`
```

## Indicator detail {.flow}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| fill: false
{
  if (!selected_case_definitions.length) {
    return html`<div class="bnr-note-box">Select <strong>Primary</strong>, <strong>Inclusive</strong>, or both under Mortality definition.</div>`
  }

  const rangeStartIndex = Math.min(Math.round(selected_start_period_index), Math.round(selected_end_period_index))
  const rangeEndIndex = Math.max(Math.round(selected_start_period_index), Math.round(selected_end_period_index))
  const selectedPeriodKeys = new Set(available_periods.slice(rangeStartIndex, rangeEndIndex + 1).map(d => d.key))
  const inRange = d => selectedPeriodKeys.has(d.period)

  const pairSegments = (rows, include) => rows.slice(1).flatMap((d, i) => include(rows[i], d) ? [{...rows[i], segment: i}, {...d, segment: i}] : [])
  const adjacentPeriods = (a, b) => {
    if (a.period_type !== b.period_type) return false
    if (a.period_type === "annual") return b.period_year === a.period_year + 1
    if (a.period_type === "quarterly") {
      const aq = a.period_year * 4 + a.period_quarter
      const bq = b.period_year * 4 + b.period_quarter
      return bq === aq + 1
    }
    const am = a.period_year * 12 + a.period_month
    const bm = b.period_year * 12 + b.period_month
    return bm === am + 1
  }
  const contiguousObservedSegments = rows => {
    const ordered = sortedRows(rows)
    return pairSegments(ordered, (a, b) => adjacentPeriods(a, b) && isSafe(a) && isSafe(b) && isComplete(a) && isComplete(b))
  }

  const monthlyYtd = (definition, latestMonthly) => {
    if (!latestMonthly) return null
    const year = latestMonthly.period_year
    const month = latestMonthly.period_month
    const rows = burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
      d.case_definition === definition &&
      d.period_type === "monthly" &&
      d.statistic === "monthly_count" &&
      d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
      d.sex === "all" &&
      d.age_group === "all" &&
      d.period_year === year &&
      d.period_month >= 1 &&
      d.period_month <= month
    )
    const byMonth = new Map(rows.map(d => [d.period_month, d]))
    const expected = Array.from({length: month}, (_, i) => i + 1)
    const completeSet = expected.every(m => byMonth.has(m) && isComplete(byMonth.get(m)) && isSafe(byMonth.get(m)))
    if (!completeSet) return null
    return expected.reduce((sum, m) => sum + byMonth.get(m).value, 0)
  }

  const monthlySeries = definition => {
    const observedAll = sortedRows(burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
      d.case_definition === definition &&
      d.period_type === "monthly" &&
      d.statistic === "monthly_count" &&
      d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
      d.sex === "all" &&
      d.age_group === "all" &&
      inRange(d)
    ))
    const latestMonthly = latestRow(observedAll)
    const ytd = monthlyYtd(definition, latestMonthly)
    const refRows = monthly_reference.filter(d => d.case_definition === definition)
    const refByMonth = new Map(refRows.map(d => [d.period_month, d]))
    const refLatest = latestMonthly ? refByMonth.get(latestMonthly.period_month) : null
    const referenceForChart = observedAll.flatMap(d => {
      const ref = refByMonth.get(d.period_month)
      return ref ? [{...d, reference_min: ref.reference_min, reference_max: ref.reference_max, reference_mean: ref.reference_mean}] : []
    })
    const completePoints = observedAll.filter(d => isSafe(d) && isComplete(d)).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: new Date(d.period_start)}))
    const incompletePoints = observedAll.filter(d => isSafe(d) && !isComplete(d)).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: new Date(d.period_start)}))
    const completeSegments = contiguousObservedSegments(observedAll).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: new Date(d.period_start)}))
    return {definition, observedAll, latestMonthly, ytd, refLatest, referenceForChart, completePoints, incompletePoints, completeSegments}
  }

  const monthlyPanel = definitions => {
    const series = definitions.map(definition => monthlySeries(definition))
    const activeComparator = Array.isArray(selected_count_comparator) ? selected_count_comparator : []
    const showMonthlyComparator = activeComparator.includes("monthly_reference")
    const latestItems = series.map(s => ({
      definition: s.definition,
      value: s.latestMonthly ? formatValue(s.latestMonthly) : "—",
      note: s.latestMonthly ? `${periodLabel(s.latestMonthly)}${isComplete(s.latestMonthly) ? "" : " · incomplete"}` : "No published value"
    }))
    const ytdItems = series.map(s => ({
      definition: s.definition,
      value: s.ytd === null ? "—" : formatNumber(s.ytd),
      note: s.latestMonthly ? `${s.latestMonthly.period_year} to ${periodLabel(s.latestMonthly)}${s.ytd === null ? " · unavailable because one or more months are missing, incomplete or protected" : ""}` : "No published value"
    }))
    const referenceItems = series.map(s => ({
      definition: s.definition,
      value: s.refLatest ? `${formatNumber(s.refLatest.reference_min)}–${formatNumber(s.refLatest.reference_max)}` : "—",
      note: s.refLatest && s.latestMonthly ? `${periodLabel(s.latestMonthly)} · mean ${formatNumber(s.refLatest.reference_mean)}` : "Fixed 2015–2019 reference"
    }))

    // Keep the monthly count y-axis stable while mortality definitions are toggled.
    // The domain always considers both approved mortality definitions over the visible
    // period range, plus the fixed reference maxima when that comparator is shown.
    const monthlyScaleDefinitions = ["primary_clear_likely", "upper_clear_likely_possible"]
    const monthlyScaleRows = burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
      monthlyScaleDefinitions.includes(d.case_definition) &&
      d.period_type === "monthly" &&
      d.statistic === "monthly_count" &&
      d.event_type === "all_cvd" &&
      d.sex === "all" &&
      d.age_group === "all" &&
      inRange(d) &&
      isSafe(d)
    )
    const visibleCalendarMonths = new Set(monthlyScaleRows.map(d => d.period_month))
    const monthlyReferenceScaleMaxima = showMonthlyComparator
      ? monthly_reference.filter(d =>
          monthlyScaleDefinitions.includes(d.case_definition) &&
          visibleCalendarMonths.has(d.period_month)
        ).map(d => d.reference_max)
      : []
    const yCandidates = [
      ...monthlyScaleRows.map(d => d.value),
      ...monthlyReferenceScaleMaxima
    ].filter(Number.isFinite)
    const yMax = yCandidates.length ? Math.max(...yCandidates) : 1
    const sharedYDomain = [0, yMax * 1.05]

    const chartFor = s => {
      const seriesColour = definitionColour(s.definition)
      return html`<div class="bnr-monthly-chart">
        <div class="bnr-chart-title" style=${`color:${seriesColour}`}>${definitionLabel(s.definition)}</div>
        <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:${seriesColour}`}></span>Monthly count</span>
          ${showMonthlyComparator ? html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style=${`background:${colour("referenceBand")}`}></span>2015–2019 range</span>
          <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:${colour("referenceMean")}`}></span>2015–2019 average</span>` : ""}
        </div>
        <div class="bnr-axis-title">↑ Count</div>
        ${Plot.plot({
          height: 390,
          marginLeft: 80,
          marginBottom: 70,
          style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
          x: {label: "Month", type: "time"},
          y: {label: null, grid: true, domain: sharedYDomain, nice: true},
          marks: [
            ...(showMonthlyComparator ? [
              Plot.areaY(s.referenceForChart, {x: d => new Date(d.period_start), y1: "reference_min", y2: "reference_max", fill: colour("referenceBand")}),
              Plot.lineY(s.referenceForChart, {x: d => new Date(d.period_start), y: "reference_mean", stroke: colour("referenceMean"), strokeWidth: 2.5})
            ] : []),
            Plot.lineY(s.completeSegments, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", z: "segment", stroke: seriesColour, strokeWidth: 2}),
            Plot.dot(s.completePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", fill: seriesColour, stroke: seriesColour, r: 3.5, title: d => `${periodLabel(d)}\n${formatValue(d)}\nComplete month`}),
            Plot.dot(s.incompletePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", fill: "#f6c98a", fillOpacity: .32, stroke: "#d98b3d", strokeOpacity: .9, strokeWidth: 1.7, r: 7}),
            Plot.dot(s.incompletePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", fill: seriesColour, stroke: seriesColour, r: 4.2, title: d => `${periodLabel(d)}\n${formatValue(d)}\nIncomplete month`}),
            Plot.ruleY([0])
          ]
        })}
      </div>`
    }

    return html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
      <div class="bnr-section-title">Monthly CVD deaths</div>
      ${definitionSelection(definitions)}
      <div class="bnr-chart-title">Monthly all-CVD deaths, both sexes, all ages</div>
      <p class="bnr-trend-note">${showMonthlyComparator ? "The shaded band shows the lowest and highest count for the same calendar month during 2015–2019. The orange line shows the 2015–2019 average." : "The 2015–2019 historical reference can be added using Comparator."}</p>
      <div class="bnr-monthly-stack">${series.map(chartFor)}</div>
      <div class="bnr-card-grid" style="margin-top:.75rem">
        ${headlineByDefinition("Latest month", latestItems)}
        ${headlineByDefinition("Year to date", ytdItems)}
        ${showMonthlyComparator ? headlineByDefinition("2015–2019 reference range", referenceItems) : ""}
      </div>
    </div>`
  }

  const countPanel = definitions => {
    const statistic = `${selected_period_type}_count`
    const comparatorStatistic = selected_period_type === "quarterly"
      ? "quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean"
      : "annual_previous_5yr_mean"
    const chartX = d => selected_period_type === "annual" ? Number(d.period_year) : new Date(d.period_start)
    const activeCountSexes = Array.isArray(selected_count_sexes) ? selected_count_sexes : ["all"]
    const activeCountAgeGroups =
      selected_period_type === "annual" && selected_event_type === "all_cvd"
        ? (Array.isArray(selected_age_groups) ? selected_age_groups : ["all"])
        : ["all"]
    const activeComparator = Array.isArray(selected_count_comparator) ? selected_count_comparator : []
    const showRollingComparator = activeComparator.includes("rolling_5yr")
    const countSexLabel = d => ({all: "Both sexes", female: "Women", male: "Men"})[d] || d
    const countSexDash = d => ({all: null, female: "8,5", male: "2,4"})[d] ?? null
    const countSexLegendStyle = d => d === "female" ? "dashed" : d === "male" ? "dotted" : "solid"
    const countAgeSymbol = d => ({all: "circle", under_70: "triangle", age_70_plus: "square"})[d] || "circle"
    const countAgeLegendSymbol = d => ({all: "●", under_70: "▲", age_70_plus: "■"})[d] || "●"

    const series = definitions.map(definition => {
      const observed = sortedRows(burden.filter(d =>
        d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
        d.case_definition === definition &&
        d.period_type === selected_period_type &&
        d.statistic === statistic &&
        d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
        activeCountAgeGroups.includes(d.age_group) &&
        inRange(d) &&
        ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex)
      ))
      const comparator = sortedRows(burden.filter(d =>
        d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
        d.case_definition === definition &&
        d.period_type === selected_period_type &&
        d.statistic === comparatorStatistic &&
        d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
        activeCountAgeGroups.includes(d.age_group) &&
        inRange(d) &&
        ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex) &&
        hasPublishedValue(d)
      ))
      return {definition, observed, comparator}
    })

    const latestItem = (s, sex, ageGroup) => {
      const row = latestRow(s.observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex && d.age_group === ageGroup))
      return {
        definition: s.definition,
        value: row ? formatValue(row) : "—",
        note: row ? `${periodLabel(row)}${isComplete(row) ? "" : " · incomplete"}` : "No published value"
      }
    }
    const comparatorItem = (s, sex, ageGroup) => {
      const observedLatest = latestRow(s.observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex && d.age_group === ageGroup))
      const row = observedLatest
        ? s.comparator.find(d => d.sex === sex && d.age_group === ageGroup && d.period === observedLatest.period) || null
        : null
      return {
        definition: s.definition,
        value: row ? formatValue(row) : "—",
        note: row ? periodLabel(row) : "Not available in the published release"
      }
    }

    const cardsForAge = (ageGroup, comparator = false) => html`<div class="bnr-age-card-group">
      ${activeCountAgeGroups.length > 1 || ageGroup !== "all" ? html`<div class="bnr-age-card-label">${ageLabel(ageGroup)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="bnr-card-grid">
        ${headlineByDefinition(comparator ? "5-year average: all" : "Latest: all", series.map(s => comparator ? comparatorItem(s, "all", ageGroup) : latestItem(s, "all", ageGroup)))}
        ${headlineByDefinition(comparator ? "5-year average: women" : "Latest: women", series.map(s => comparator ? comparatorItem(s, "female", ageGroup) : latestItem(s, "female", ageGroup)))}
        ${headlineByDefinition(comparator ? "5-year average: men" : "Latest: men", series.map(s => comparator ? comparatorItem(s, "male", ageGroup) : latestItem(s, "male", ageGroup)))}
      </div>
    </div>`

    const latestCards = html`<div>${activeCountAgeGroups.map(ageGroup => cardsForAge(ageGroup, false))}</div>`
    const comparatorCards = html`<div>${activeCountAgeGroups.map(ageGroup => cardsForAge(ageGroup, true))}</div>`

    const marks = series.flatMap(s => activeCountSexes.flatMap(sex => activeCountAgeGroups.flatMap(ageGroup => {
      const seriesColour = definitionColour(s.definition)
      const observedRows = s.observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex && d.age_group === ageGroup)
      const completePoints = observedRows.filter(d => isSafe(d) && isComplete(d)).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: chartX(d)}))
      const incompletePoints = observedRows.filter(d => isSafe(d) && !isComplete(d)).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: chartX(d)}))
      const completeSegments = contiguousObservedSegments(observedRows).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: chartX(d)}))
      const sexDash = countSexDash(sex)
      const pointSymbol = countAgeSymbol(ageGroup)
      const observedLineOptions = {x: "chart_x", y: "value", z: "segment", stroke: seriesColour, strokeWidth: 2.3}
      if (sexDash) observedLineOptions.strokeDasharray = sexDash
      const comparatorRows = s.comparator.filter(d => d.sex === sex && d.age_group === ageGroup).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: chartX(d)}))
      const comparatorLineOptions = {x: "chart_x", y: "value", stroke: seriesColour, strokeOpacity: .42, strokeWidth: 1.5}
      if (sexDash) comparatorLineOptions.strokeDasharray = sexDash
      return [
        Plot.lineY(completeSegments, observedLineOptions),
        Plot.dot(completePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", symbol: pointSymbol, fill: seriesColour, stroke: seriesColour, r: 3.8, title: d => `${definitionLabel(s.definition)} · ${countSexLabel(sex)} · ${ageLabel(ageGroup)}
${periodLabel(d)}
${formatValue(d)}
${selected_period_type === "quarterly" ? "Complete quarter" : "Complete year"}`}),
        Plot.dot(incompletePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", symbol: pointSymbol, fill: "#f6c98a", fillOpacity: .32, stroke: "#d98b3d", strokeOpacity: .9, strokeWidth: 1.7, r: 7}),
        Plot.dot(incompletePoints, {x: "chart_x", y: "value", symbol: pointSymbol, fill: seriesColour, stroke: seriesColour, r: 4.5, title: d => `${definitionLabel(s.definition)} · ${countSexLabel(sex)} · ${ageLabel(ageGroup)}
${periodLabel(d)}
${formatValue(d)}
${selected_period_type === "quarterly" ? "Incomplete quarter" : "Incomplete year"}`}),
        ...(showRollingComparator ? [Plot.lineY(comparatorRows, comparatorLineOptions)] : [])
      ]
    })))

    // Keep the count y-axis stable while mortality-definition, age-group or sex
    // checkboxes are toggled. The scale always considers both approved mortality
    // definitions, all published sex strata and all available age groups for the
    // current event type and visible period range. No values are derived.
    const countScaleDefinitions = ["primary_clear_likely", "upper_clear_likely_possible"]
    const scaleAgeGroups = selected_period_type === "annual" && selected_event_type === "all_cvd"
      ? ["all", "under_70", "age_70_plus"]
      : ["all"]
    const scaleStatistics = [statistic, ...(showRollingComparator ? [comparatorStatistic] : [])]
    const scaleValues = burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
      countScaleDefinitions.includes(d.case_definition) &&
      d.period_type === selected_period_type &&
      scaleStatistics.includes(d.statistic) &&
      d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
      scaleAgeGroups.includes(d.age_group) &&
      ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex) &&
      inRange(d) &&
      hasPublishedValue(d)
    ).map(d => d.value).filter(Number.isFinite)
    const countYMax = scaleValues.length ? Math.max(...scaleValues) : 1
    const sharedCountYDomain = [0, countYMax * 1.05]

    const selectedSexText = activeCountSexes.map(countSexLabel).join(", ")
    const selectedAgeText = activeCountAgeGroups.map(ageLabel).join(", ")
    return html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
      <div class="bnr-section-title">${selected_period_type === "quarterly" ? "Quarterly detail" : "Annual detail"}</div>
      ${definitionSelection(definitions)}
      <div class="bnr-chart-title">Trend for ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)} · ${selectedSexText} · ${selectedAgeText}</div>
      <p class="bnr-trend-note">Showing ${available_periods[rangeStartIndex]?.label || "—"} to ${available_periods[rangeEndIndex]?.label || "—"}.${showRollingComparator ? " The published five-year rolling average is shown with lighter lines where available." : " Add the five-year rolling average using Comparator."}</p>
      <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
        ${definitions.map(d => html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:${definitionColour(d)}`}></span>${definitionLabel(d)}</span>`)}
        ${activeCountSexes.map(d => html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:#555;border-top-style:${countSexLegendStyle(d)}`}></span>${countSexLabel(d)}</span>`)}
        ${activeCountAgeGroups.map(d => html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-age-legend-symbol">${countAgeLegendSymbol(d)}</span>${ageLabel(d)}</span>`)}
        ${showRollingComparator ? html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style="border-color:#666;opacity:.42;border-top-width:2px"></span>5-year rolling average</span>` : ""}
      </div>
      <div class="bnr-axis-title">↑ Count</div>
      ${Plot.plot({
        height: 470,
        marginLeft: 80,
        marginBottom: 76,
        style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
        x: selected_period_type === "annual" ? {label: "Year", type: "linear", tickFormat: "d"} : {label: "Quarter", type: "time"},
        y: {label: null, grid: true, domain: sharedCountYDomain, nice: true},
        marks: [...marks, Plot.ruleY([0])]
      })}
      <div style="margin-top:.75rem">
        ${latestCards}
        ${showRollingComparator ? comparatorCards : ""}
      </div>
    </div>`
  }

  if (selected_indicator === "rates") {
    if (!selected_rate_sexes.length) {
      return html`<div class="bnr-note-box">Select <strong>Both sexes</strong>, <strong>Women</strong>, <strong>Men</strong>, or a combination under Sex.</div>`
    }

    const statistic = rateStatistic(selected_rate_measure)
    const ageGroup = rateAgeGroup(selected_rate_measure)
    const activeRateUncertainty = Array.isArray(selected_rate_uncertainty) ? selected_rate_uncertainty : []
    const showStatisticalCi = activeRateUncertainty.includes("statistical_ci")

    // Keep all three published sex strata available for the summary cards even
    // when only a subset is selected for the chart.
    const definitionRows = selected_case_definitions.map(definition => ({
      definition,
      observed: sortedRows(burden.filter(d =>
        d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" &&
        d.period_type === "annual" &&
        d.statistic === statistic &&
        d.age_group === ageGroup &&
        d.case_definition === definition &&
        d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
        ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex) &&
        inRange(d)
      ))
    }))

    const rateSeries = definitionRows.flatMap(s => selected_rate_sexes.map(sex => {
      const observed = s.observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex)
      const safe = observed.filter(d => isSafe(d))
      return {
        definition: s.definition,
        sex,
        observed,
        complete: safe.filter(d => isComplete(d)),
        incomplete: safe.filter(d => !isComplete(d)),
        segments: contiguousObservedSegments(observed).map(d => ({...d, chart_x: Number(d.period_year)})),
        ci: safe.filter(d => Number.isFinite(d.ci_lower_value) && Number.isFinite(d.ci_upper_value))
      }
    }))

    const latestItems = sex => definitionRows.map(s => {
      const row = latestRow(s.observed.filter(d => d.sex === sex))
      const noteParts = row ? [`${periodLabel(row)} · per 100,000`] : []
      if (
        row &&
        showStatisticalCi &&
        isSafe(row) &&
        Number.isFinite(row.ci_lower_value) &&
        Number.isFinite(row.ci_upper_value)
      ) {
        noteParts.push(`95% CI ${rateInterval(row)}`)
      }
      return {
        definition: s.definition,
        value: rateValue(row),
        note: row ? noteParts.join(" · ") : "No published value"
      }
    })

    // Hold the mortality-rate y-axis fixed while sex and mortality-definition
    // series are toggled, but allow crude and age-standardised rates to use
    // different domains. The scale therefore uses all three sex strata, both
    // mortality definitions and released CI upper limits for the selected CVD
    // type, rate measure and year range.
    const allRateScaleRows = burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" &&
      d.period_type === "annual" &&
      d.statistic === statistic &&
      d.age_group === ageGroup &&
      d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
      ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex) &&
      inRange(d) &&
      isSafe(d)
    )
    const scaleValues = allRateScaleRows.flatMap(d => [d.value, d.ci_upper_value]).filter(Number.isFinite)
    const yMax = scaleValues.length ? Math.max(...scaleValues) * 1.05 : 1

    const marks = rateSeries.flatMap(s => {
      const c = definitionColour(s.definition)
      const dash = rateSexDash(s.sex)
      return [
        ...(showStatisticalCi ? [Plot.link(s.ci, {
          x1: d => Number(d.period_year), x2: d => Number(d.period_year),
          y1: "ci_lower_value", y2: "ci_upper_value",
          stroke: c, strokeOpacity: .42, strokeWidth: 1.25
        })] : []),
        Plot.lineY(s.segments, {
          x: "chart_x", y: "value", z: "segment",
          stroke: c, strokeWidth: s.sex === "all" ? 2.6 : 2.2,
          ...(dash ? {strokeDasharray: dash} : {})
        }),
        Plot.dot(s.complete, {
          x: d => Number(d.period_year), y: "value",
          fill: c, stroke: c, r: s.sex === "all" ? 3.7 : 3.3,
          title: d => `${definitionLabel(s.definition)} · ${rateSexLabel(s.sex)}
${periodLabel(d)}
${rateValue(d)} per 100,000
95% CI: ${rateInterval(d)}
Complete year`
        }),
        Plot.dot(s.incomplete, {
          x: d => Number(d.period_year), y: "value",
          fill: "#f6c98a", fillOpacity: .32,
          stroke: "#d98b3d", strokeOpacity: .9, strokeWidth: 1.7, r: 7
        }),
        Plot.dot(s.incomplete, {
          x: d => Number(d.period_year), y: "value",
          fill: c, stroke: c, r: 4.2,
          title: d => `${definitionLabel(s.definition)} · ${rateSexLabel(s.sex)}
${periodLabel(d)}
${rateValue(d)} per 100,000
95% CI: ${rateInterval(d)}
Incomplete year`
        })
      ]
    })

    const ratePlot = Plot.plot({
      height: 470,
      marginLeft: 96,
      marginBottom: 70,
      style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
      x: {label: "Year", type: "linear", tickFormat: "d"},
      y: {label: null, grid: true, domain: [0, yMax], nice: true},
      marks: [...marks, Plot.ruleY([0])]
    })

    const sexTitle = selected_rate_sexes.length === 3
      ? "both sexes, women and men"
      : selected_rate_sexes.map(d => rateSexLabel(d).toLowerCase()).join(", ")

    return html`<div>
      ${interpretation(
        "Annual mortality rates",
        `The published annual ${selected_rate_measure === "asr" ? "age-standardised" : "crude"} mortality rate per 100,000 population for ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)} deaths.`,
        "Use the same mortality definition and CVD type when comparing rates. Sex strata can be overlaid on the same chart. Confidence intervals are supplied with the published estimates; the dashboard does not calculate them."
      )}
      <hr>
      <div class="bnr-definition-panel">
        <div class="bnr-section-title">${selected_rate_measure === "asr" ? "Age-standardised rate" : "Crude rate"}</div>
        ${definitionSelection(selected_case_definitions)}
        <div class="bnr-chart-title">Trend for ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)}, ${sexTitle}</div>
        <p class="bnr-trend-note">Showing ${available_periods[rangeStartIndex]?.label || "—"} to ${available_periods[rangeEndIndex]?.label || "—"}. Lines${showStatisticalCi ? " and confidence intervals" : ""} break where a published value is protected, incomplete or unavailable.</p>
        <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
          ${selected_case_definitions.map(d => html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:${definitionColour(d)}`}></span>${definitionLabel(d)}</span>`)}
          ${selected_rate_sexes.map(d => html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-line" style=${`border-color:#555;border-top-style:${rateSexLegendStyle(d)}`}></span>${rateSexLabel(d)}</span>`)}
          ${showStatisticalCi ? html`<span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-whisker"></span>95% statistical CI</span>` : ""}
        </div>
        <div class="bnr-axis-title">↑ Rate per 100,000</div>
        ${ratePlot}
        ${downloadPlot(ratePlot, `${release_id || "mort-current"}-rate-${selected_rate_measure}-${selected_event_type}`)}
        <div class="bnr-card-grid" style="margin-top:.75rem">
          ${headlineByDefinition("Latest: all", latestItems("all"))}
          ${headlineByDefinition("Latest: women", latestItems("female"))}
          ${headlineByDefinition("Latest: men", latestItems("male"))}
        </div>
        <div class="bnr-note-box"><strong>Uncertainty:</strong> The 95% statistical confidence intervals shown here are supplied in the approved public dataset. They describe statistical variation around the central estimate and are not recalculated or combined with another uncertainty measure.</div>
        <div class="bnr-note-box"><strong>Population:</strong> UN World Population Prospects 2024. ${selected_rate_measure === "asr" ? html`<strong>Standard population:</strong> WHO World 2000–2025.` : ""}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`
  }

  if (selected_indicator === "counts") {
    if (["quarterly", "annual"].includes(selected_period_type) && !selected_count_sexes.length) {
      return html`<div class="bnr-note-box">Select <strong>Both sexes</strong>, <strong>Women</strong>, <strong>Men</strong>, or a combination under Sex.</div>`
    }
    const bothSexesOnlyForAge =
      Array.isArray(selected_count_sexes) &&
      selected_count_sexes.length === 1 &&
      selected_count_sexes[0] === "all"
    if (selected_period_type === "annual" && selected_event_type === "all_cvd" && bothSexesOnlyForAge && !selected_age_groups.length) {
      return html`<div class="bnr-note-box">Select <strong>All ages</strong>, <strong>Under 70</strong>, <strong>70 and older</strong>, or a combination under Age group.</div>`
    }
    const intro = selected_period_type === "monthly"
      ? interpretation(
          "Monthly CVD deaths",
          "The number of deaths classified as CVD each month. Monthly data are shown only for All CVD, both sexes and all ages.",
          "The fixed 2015–2019 historical reference can be added with Comparator. If a value is protected, it is not plotted and is not treated as zero."
        )
      : selected_period_type === "quarterly"
      ? interpretation(
          "Quarterly CVD deaths",
          `The number of deaths classified as ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)} in each quarter. The cards show the latest published counts for all, women and men, and the chart can show one or more sex series.`,
          "Use Sex to compare published sex-specific trends. The five-year rolling average can be added with Comparator where it is available. Protected values are not plotted and are not treated as zero."
        )
      : interpretation(
          "Annual CVD deaths",
          `The number of deaths classified as ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)} in each year. The cards show the latest published counts for all, women and men. For All CVD, the chart can also compare one or more broad age groups.`,
          "Use Sex and, for All CVD, Age group to compare published trends. The five-year rolling average can be added with Comparator where it is available. Protected values are not plotted and are not treated as zero."
        )
    return html`<div>
      ${intro}
      <hr>
      ${selected_period_type === "monthly" ? monthlyPanel(selected_case_definitions) : countPanel(selected_case_definitions)}
    </div>`
  }

  const safeCompleteGroup = (rows, key, expected) => {
    const grouped = new Map()
    rows.forEach(d => {
      const k = d.period
      if (!grouped.has(k)) grouped.set(k, [])
      grouped.get(k).push(d)
    })
    return Array.from(grouped.values()).flatMap(group => {
      const keys = new Set(group.map(d => d[key]))
      const safe = expected.every(v => keys.has(v)) && group.every(d => isSafe(d) && isComplete(d))
      return safe ? group : []
    })
  }

  const distributionData = definition => {
    const profileRows = burden.filter(d =>
      d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-002" &&
      d.case_definition === definition &&
      d.period_type === "annual" &&
      inRange(d)
    )
    const allCvdSelected = selected_event_type === "all_cvd"
    const eventRows = sortedRows(safeCompleteGroup(
      profileRows.filter(d => d.statistic === "event_type_distribution" && d.sex === "all" && ["heart", "stroke"].includes(d.event_type)),
      "event_type",
      ["heart", "stroke"]
    ))
    const ageRows = allCvdSelected ? sortedRows(safeCompleteGroup(
      profileRows.filter(d => d.statistic === "age_distribution" && d.event_type === "all_cvd" && d.sex === "all" && ["under_70", "age_70_plus"].includes(d.age_group)),
      "age_group",
      ["under_70", "age_70_plus"]
    )) : []
    const sexRows = sortedRows(safeCompleteGroup(
      profileRows.filter(d => d.statistic === "sex_distribution" && d.event_type === selected_event_type && ["female", "male"].includes(d.sex)),
      "sex",
      ["female", "male"]
    ))
    return {definition, eventRows, ageRows, sexRows}
  }

  const latestYearRows = rows => {
    const years = rows.map(d => d.period_year)
    const year = years.length ? Math.max(...years) : null
    return year === null ? [] : rows.filter(d => d.period_year === year)
  }
  const stackRows = (rows, key, order) => Array.from(new Set(rows.map(d => d.period_year))).flatMap(year => {
    let total = 0
    return rows
      .filter(d => d.period_year === year)
      .sort((a, b) => order.indexOf(a[key]) - order.indexOf(b[key]))
      .map(d => {
        const x1 = total
        total += d.value
        return {...d, x1, x2: total, year_label: String(year)}
      })
  })

  const distributionParts = kind => {
    const key = kind === "event" ? "event_type" : kind === "age" ? "age_group" : "sex"
    const order = kind === "event" ? ["heart", "stroke"] : kind === "age" ? ["under_70", "age_70_plus"] : ["female", "male"]
    const firstLabel = kind === "event" ? "Heart" : kind === "age" ? "Under 70" : "Women"
    const secondLabel = kind === "event" ? "Stroke" : kind === "age" ? "70 and older" : "Men"
    const firstColour = kind === "event" ? colour("heart") : kind === "age" ? colour("under70") : colour("women")
    const secondColour = kind === "event" ? colour("stroke") : kind === "age" ? colour("older70") : colour("men")
    return {key, order, firstLabel, secondLabel, firstColour, secondColour}
  }

  const distributionRows = (data, kind) => kind === "event" ? data.eventRows : kind === "age" ? data.ageRows : data.sexRows

  // Distribution headline cards are shared across the selected definitions, exactly
  // as on the count view. With both definitions selected each category card shows
  // both published percentages and one common year where the year is the same.
  const distributionSummary = kind => {
    const parts = distributionParts(kind)
    const categoryItems = categoryKey => distributionSets.map(data => {
      const latest = latestYearRows(distributionRows(data, kind))
      const row = latest.find(d => d[parts.key] === categoryKey) || null
      return {
        definition: data.definition,
        value: row ? formatValue(row) : "—",
        note: row ? String(row.period_year) : "No published value"
      }
    })
    return html`<div class="bnr-card-grid bnr-distribution-summary" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(140px,1fr))">
      ${headlineByDefinition(`Latest: ${parts.firstLabel.toLowerCase()}`, categoryItems(parts.order[0]))}
      ${headlineByDefinition(`Latest: ${parts.secondLabel.toLowerCase()}`, categoryItems(parts.order[1]))}
    </div>`
  }

  const distributionChart = (data, kind) => {
    const definition = data.definition
    const rows = distributionRows(data, kind)
    if (!rows.length) return ""
    const parts = distributionParts(kind)
    const stack = stackRows(rows, parts.key, parts.order)
    const years = Array.from(new Set(stack.map(d => d.year_label)))
    const showEvery = years.length > 20 ? 2 : 1
    const labelFor = d => kind === "event" ? eventLabel(d[parts.key]) : kind === "age" ? ageLabel(d[parts.key]) : sexLabel(d[parts.key])
    return html`<div class="bnr-distribution-card" style=${`border-left-color:${definitionColour(definition)}`}>
      <div class="bnr-distribution-definition" style=${`color:${definitionColour(definition)}`}>${definitionLabel(definition)}</div>
      <div class="bnr-chart-legend">
        <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style=${`background:${parts.firstColour}`}></span>${parts.firstLabel}</span>
        <span class="bnr-chart-legend-item"><span class="bnr-legend-swatch" style=${`background:${parts.secondColour}`}></span>${parts.secondLabel}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="bnr-axis-title">Percent of deaths</div>
      ${Plot.plot({
        height: 330,
        marginLeft: 70,
        marginBottom: 60,
        style: {fontSize: "15px", fontFamily: "inherit"},
        x: {label: "Year", domain: years, tickFormat: d => years.indexOf(d) % showEvery === 0 ? d : ""},
        y: {label: null, domain: [0,100], grid: true},
        color: {domain: parts.order, range: [parts.firstColour, parts.secondColour], legend: false},
        marks: [
          Plot.barY(stack, {x: "year_label", y1: "x1", y2: "x2", fill: parts.key, insetLeft: 3, insetRight: 3, title: d => `${d.period_year}\n${labelFor(d)}\n${formatValue(d)}`}),
          Plot.ruleY([0])
        ]
      })}
    </div>`
  }

  const distributionSets = selected_case_definitions.map(definition => distributionData(definition))
  const eventGroup = distributionSets.some(d => d.eventRows.length) ? html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
    <div class="bnr-section-title">Heart and stroke: All CVD</div>
    <div class="bnr-distribution-stack">${distributionSets.map(d => distributionChart(d, "event"))}</div>
    ${distributionSummary("event")}
  </div>` : ""
  const ageGroup = distributionSets.some(d => d.ageRows.length) ? html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
    <div class="bnr-section-title">Age groups: All CVD</div>
    <div class="bnr-distribution-stack">${distributionSets.map(d => distributionChart(d, "age"))}</div>
    ${distributionSummary("age")}
  </div>` : ""
  const sexGroup = distributionSets.some(d => d.sexRows.length) ? html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
    <div class="bnr-section-title">Women and men: ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)}</div>
    <div class="bnr-distribution-stack">${distributionSets.map(d => distributionChart(d, "sex"))}</div>
    ${distributionSummary("sex")}
  </div>` : ""

  return html`<div>
    ${interpretation(
      "How CVD deaths are distributed",
      selected_event_type === "all_cvd"
        ? "The percentage of CVD deaths that are Heart or Stroke, under 70 or 70 and older, and women or men."
        : `The percentage split between women and men for ${eventLabel(selected_event_type)}, alongside the overall Heart and Stroke split.`,
      "These percentages describe the mix of deaths in the BNR data. They are not death rates and they do not show a person's risk of dying. BNR mortality categories are not necessarily the same as official international ICD-10 mortality statistics. A chart is omitted if any part of the distribution is incomplete or protected."
    )}
    <hr>
    ${eventGroup}
    ${ageGroup}
    ${sexGroup}
  </div>`
}
```

## Possible deaths {height=525}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// This matrix is a deliberately permitted presentation-derived measure.
// For each year and CVD type, it subtracts the published Primary annual count from
// the published Inclusive annual count, then expresses that difference as a share
// of the Inclusive annual count so All CVD, Heart and Stroke are directly comparable.
// No value is calculated if either source count is incomplete, protected, missing
// or non-numeric.
{
  const annualRows = burden.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
    d.period_type === "annual" &&
    d.statistic === "annual_count" &&
    d.sex === "all" &&
    d.age_group === "all" &&
    ["all_cvd", "heart", "stroke"].includes(d.event_type)
  )
  const yearsPresent = annualRows.map(d => d.period_year).filter(Number.isFinite)
  const lastYear = yearsPresent.length ? Math.max(...yearsPresent) : null
  const years = lastYear === null || lastYear < 2010
    ? []
    : Array.from({length: lastYear - 2010 + 1}, (_, i) => 2010 + i)
  const yearsBefore2018 = years.filter(year => year < 2018)
  const yearsFrom2018 = years.filter(year => year >= 2018)
  const events = [
    {key: "all_cvd", label: "All CVD"},
    {key: "heart", label: "Heart"},
    {key: "stroke", label: "Stroke"}
  ]
  const rowFor = (eventType, year, definition) => annualRows.find(d =>
    d.event_type === eventType &&
    d.period_year === year &&
    d.case_definition === definition
  ) || null
  const possibleOnly = (eventType, year) => {
    const primary = rowFor(eventType, year, "primary_clear_likely")
    const inclusive = rowFor(eventType, year, "upper_clear_likely_possible")
    if (!primary || !inclusive || !isComplete(primary) || !isComplete(inclusive) || !isSafe(primary) || !isSafe(inclusive)) return null
    const difference = inclusive.value - primary.value
    if (!Number.isFinite(difference) || difference < 0 || !Number.isFinite(inclusive.value) || inclusive.value <= 0) return null
    const possibleShare = 100 * difference / inclusive.value
    if (!Number.isFinite(possibleShare)) return null
    return {difference, possibleShare, primary: primary.value, inclusive: inclusive.value}
  }
  const qualityRounded = possibleShare => Math.round(possibleShare)
  const qualityStyle = possibleShare => {
    const rounded = qualityRounded(possibleShare)
    return rounded < 20 ? "background:#d6eddf;color:#235b42;" :
      rounded < 30 ? "background:#ffe7a8;color:#6b5600;" :
      "background:#f3c6cc;color:#842029;"
  }
  const qualityPercent = x => `${qualityRounded(x)}%`
  const yearCellClass = year => year === 2018 ? "bnr-quality-era-start" : ""

  const qualityPanel = html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
    <div class="bnr-section-title">How much does the estimate rely on Possible deaths?</div>
    <p class="bnr-trend-note">Each number is the percentage of deaths in the <strong>Inclusive</strong> estimate that are not in the <strong>Primary</strong> estimate. In simple terms, it shows how much the estimate depends on deaths classified as <strong>Possible</strong>. Hover over a number to see the death counts behind the percentage.</p>
    <div class="bnr-quality-key">
      <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-low"></span><strong>Lower:</strong> &lt;20</span>
      <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-medium"></span><strong>Moderate:</strong> 20-29</span>
      <span class="bnr-quality-key-item"><span class="bnr-quality-swatch bnr-quality-swatch-high"></span><strong>Higher:</strong> 30+</span>
    </div>
    <div class="bnr-coverage-scroll">
      <table class="bnr-coverage-table" aria-label="Deaths classified as Possible as a percentage of Inclusive annual deaths by year and CVD type">
        <thead>
          <tr class="bnr-quality-era-row">
            <th></th>
            ${yearsBefore2018.length ? html`<th colspan=${yearsBefore2018.length} class="bnr-quality-era-old">2010-2017 · causes stored together</th>` : ""}
            ${yearsFrom2018.length ? html`<th colspan=${yearsFrom2018.length} class="bnr-quality-era-new bnr-quality-era-start">2018 onward · certificate lines stored separately</th>` : ""}
          </tr>
          <tr><th></th>${years.map(year => html`<th scope="col" class=${yearCellClass(year)}>${year}</th>`)}</tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          ${events.map(event => html`<tr>
            <th scope="row" class="bnr-coverage-label">${event.label}</th>
            ${years.map(year => {
              const result = possibleOnly(event.key, year)
              const eraClass = yearCellClass(year)
              return result
                ? html`<td class=${`bnr-coverage-cell bnr-quality-cell ${eraClass}`}><span class="bnr-quality-value" style=${qualityStyle(result.possibleShare)} data-event=${event.key} data-year=${year} tabindex="0">${qualityRounded(result.possibleShare)}</span></td>`
                : html`<td class=${`bnr-coverage-cell bnr-quality-cell bnr-quality-unavailable ${eraClass}`}>-</td>`
            })}
          </tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="bnr-quality-hover-detail">Hover over a number to see the death counts behind that percentage.</div>
    <div class="bnr-note-box"><strong>Why 2018 and later look different:</strong> Before 2018, causes of death were usually stored together in one text field, so the original order on the death certificate was not available. From 2018, the certificate lines were stored separately. This lets BNR show uncertainty more clearly, so more deaths can appear as Possible. A higher percentage after 2018 does <strong>not</strong> necessarily mean that the data became worse. Values before and after 2018 should therefore be compared with care. The colours show lower, moderate and higher percentages only; they are not a judgement of data quality.</div>
  </div>`

  const hoverDetail = qualityPanel.querySelector(".bnr-quality-hover-detail")
  const resetHoverDetail = () => {
    hoverDetail.textContent = "Hover over a number to see the death counts behind that percentage."
    hoverDetail.classList.remove("bnr-quality-hover-active")
  }

  qualityPanel.querySelectorAll(".bnr-quality-value[data-event][data-year]").forEach(cell => {
    const showHoverDetail = () => {
      const eventType = cell.getAttribute("data-event")
      const year = Number(cell.getAttribute("data-year"))
      const event = events.find(item => item.key === eventType)
      const result = possibleOnly(eventType, year)

      if (!event || !result) {
        resetHoverDetail()
        return
      }

      hoverDetail.textContent = `${event.label}, ${year} (difference ${qualityPercent(result.possibleShare)}) · Total Inclusive deaths: ${formatNumber(result.inclusive)} · Clear + Likely: ${formatNumber(result.primary)} · Possible: ${formatNumber(result.difference)}`
      hoverDetail.classList.add("bnr-quality-hover-active")
    }
    cell.addEventListener("mouseenter", showHoverDetail)
    cell.addEventListener("focus", showHoverDetail)
    cell.addEventListener("mouseleave", resetHoverDetail)
    cell.addEventListener("blur", resetHoverDetail)
  })

  return qualityPanel
}
```

## Coverage {height=375}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Data coverage is a publication-layer presence matrix. It records whether the
// current approved public dataset contains rows for each frequency and year; it
// does not calculate an analytical result.
{
  const countRows = burden.filter(d =>
    d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
    ["monthly_count", "quarterly_count", "annual_count"].includes(d.statistic)
  )
  const yearsPresent = countRows.map(d => d.period_year).filter(Number.isFinite)
  const firstYear = yearsPresent.length ? Math.min(...yearsPresent) : null
  const lastYear = yearsPresent.length ? Math.max(...yearsPresent) : null
  const years = firstYear === null ? [] : Array.from({length: lastYear - firstYear + 1}, (_, i) => firstYear + i)
  const frequencies = [
    {key: "monthly", label: "Monthly (All CVD only)"},
    {key: "quarterly", label: "Quarterly"},
    {key: "annual", label: "Annual"}
  ]
  const hasData = (type, year) => countRows.some(d => d.period_type === type && d.period_year === year)
  return html`<div class="bnr-definition-panel">
    <div class="bnr-section-title">Data coverage</div>
    <p class="bnr-trend-note">This shows which years are included in the current published release. New years will appear automatically as future releases are added.</p>
    <div class="bnr-coverage-key">
      <span><strong class="bnr-coverage-present">✓</strong> data available</span>
      <span><strong class="bnr-coverage-absent">–</strong> no data published</span>
    </div>
    <div class="bnr-coverage-scroll">
      <table class="bnr-coverage-table" aria-label="Availability of published mortality data by year and time period">
        <thead><tr><th></th>${years.map(year => html`<th scope="col">${year}</th>`)}</tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${frequencies.map(f => html`<tr>
            <th scope="row" class="bnr-coverage-label">${f.label}</th>
            ${years.map(year => hasData(f.key, year)
              ? html`<td class="bnr-coverage-cell bnr-coverage-present" title=${`${f.label}: ${year} · data available`}>✓</td>`
              : html`<td class="bnr-coverage-cell bnr-coverage-absent" title=${`${f.label}: ${year} · no data published`}>–</td>`)}
          </tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="bnr-note-box"><strong>Monthly data:</strong> All CVD, both sexes and all ages only. Quarterly and annual data also show Heart and Stroke and women and men. Annual All CVD data also include the broad age groups Under 70 and 70 and older.</div>
  </div>`
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  const rangeStartIndex = Math.min(Math.round(selected_start_period_index), Math.round(selected_end_period_index))
  const rangeEndIndex = Math.max(Math.round(selected_start_period_index), Math.round(selected_end_period_index))
  const selectedPeriodKeys = new Set(available_periods.slice(rangeStartIndex, rangeEndIndex + 1).map(d => d.key))
  const inRange = d => selectedPeriodKeys.has(d.period)

  const selectedRows = burden.filter(d => {
    if (!selected_case_definitions.includes(d.case_definition) || !inRange(d)) return false
    if (selected_indicator === "counts") {
      const activeCountSexes = selected_period_type === "monthly"
        ? ["all"]
        : (Array.isArray(selected_count_sexes) ? selected_count_sexes : ["all"])
      const activeComparator = Array.isArray(selected_count_comparator) ? selected_count_comparator : []
      const comparatorStatistic = selected_period_type === "quarterly"
        ? "quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean"
        : selected_period_type === "annual"
        ? "annual_previous_5yr_mean"
        : null
      const allowedStatistics = [`${selected_period_type}_count`]
      if (comparatorStatistic && activeComparator.includes("rolling_5yr")) allowedStatistics.push(comparatorStatistic)
      const activeCountAgeGroups = selected_period_type === "annual" && selected_event_type === "all_cvd"
        ? (Array.isArray(selected_age_groups) ? selected_age_groups : ["all"])
        : ["all"]
      return d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" &&
        d.period_type === selected_period_type &&
        d.event_type === selected_event_type &&
        activeCountAgeGroups.includes(d.age_group) &&
        activeCountSexes.includes(d.sex) &&
        allowedStatistics.includes(d.statistic)
    }
    if (selected_indicator === "rates") {
      return d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" && d.period_type === "annual" &&
        d.statistic === rateStatistic(selected_rate_measure) &&
        d.age_group === rateAgeGroup(selected_rate_measure) &&
        d.event_type === selected_event_type && ["all", "female", "male"].includes(d.sex)
    }
    if (d.metric_id !== "MORT-BURDEN-002" || d.period_type !== "annual") return false
    const eventDistribution = d.statistic === "event_type_distribution" && ["heart", "stroke"].includes(d.event_type)
    const ageDistribution = selected_event_type === "all_cvd" && d.statistic === "age_distribution" && d.event_type === "all_cvd"
    const sexDistribution = d.statistic === "sex_distribution" && d.event_type === selected_event_type
    return eventDistribution || ageDistribution || sexDistribution
  })

  const displayText = d => {
    if (d.suppression_status !== "none" || !Number.isFinite(d.value)) return d.display_value || "—"
    return d.unit === "percent" ? `${d.value.toFixed(1)}%` : d.unit === "rate_per_100000" ? d.value.toFixed(1) : Math.round(d.value).toLocaleString()
  }
  const definitionText = d => definitionLabel(d.case_definition)
  const statisticLabel = d => ({
    monthly_count: "Monthly death count",
    quarterly_count: "Quarterly death count",
    quarterly_same_quarter_previous_5yr_mean: "Average for the same quarter in the previous 5 years",
    annual_count: "Annual death count",
    annual_previous_5yr_mean: "Average for the previous 5 years",
    event_type_distribution: "Heart and Stroke distribution",
    age_distribution: "Age distribution",
    sex_distribution: "Women and men distribution",
    annual_crude_rate: "Annual crude mortality rate",
    annual_age_standardised_rate: "Annual age-standardised mortality rate"
  })[d.statistic] || String(d.statistic).replaceAll("_", " ")
  const zipName = release_id ? `bnr_mort_burden_${release_id}.zip` : ""
  const latestCount = latestRow(burden.filter(d => d.metric_id === "MORT-BURDEN-001" && ["monthly_count","quarterly_count","annual_count"].includes(d.statistic)))

  const displayRows = [...selectedRows].sort((a,b) => new Date(a.period_start)-new Date(b.period_start) || String(a.case_definition).localeCompare(String(b.case_definition)) || String(a.statistic).localeCompare(String(b.statistic)))
  const csvEscape = value => {
    const s = value === null || value === undefined ? "" : String(value)
    return /[",\r\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replaceAll('"', '""')}"` : s
  }
  const selectedViewHeaders = ["Period","Definition","CVD type","Sex","Age group","Measure","Value","95% statistical CI","CI method","Data status","Protection note"]
  const selectedViewRows = displayRows.map(d => [
    periodLabel(d),
    definitionText(d),
    eventLabel(d.event_type) || String(d.event_type).replaceAll("_", " "),
    sexLabel(d.sex) || d.sex,
    ageLabel(d.age_group) || d.age_group,
    statisticLabel(d),
    displayText(d),
    d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" ? rateInterval(d) : "",
    d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" ? ciMethodLabel(d.ci_method) : "",
    isComplete(d) ? "Complete" : "Incomplete",
    d.disclosure_note || ""
  ])
  const selectedViewCsv = [selectedViewHeaders, ...selectedViewRows].map(row => row.map(csvEscape).join(",")).join("\r\n")
  const selectedViewUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([selectedViewCsv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}))
  invalidation.then(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(selectedViewUrl))
  const definitionSlug = selected_case_definitions.map(d => d === "primary_clear_likely" ? "primary" : "inclusive").join("_") || "none"
  const indicatorSlug = selected_indicator === "counts" ? "counts" : selected_indicator === "rates" ? "rates" : "distribution"
  const selectedViewFilename = `bnr_mortality_selected_${indicatorSlug}_${effective_period_type}_${definitionSlug}_${release_id || "current"}.csv`

  const metaRows = [
    {item: "Source", value: "Published BNR mortality data"},

    {item: "Release ID", value: release_id || "—"},
    {item: "Release date", value: release_date_label},
    {item: "Latest data period", value: latestCount ? periodLabel(latestCount) : "—"},
    {item: "Status", value: "Published public release"},
    {item: "Protected values", value: "Protected values are shown exactly as published. The dashboard never tries to work them out."},
    {item: "Monthly comparison", value: "Optional fixed 2015–2019 historical reference; it does not change with each new release."}
  ]

  return html`<div class="bnr-data-page-stack">
    <div class="bnr-dashboard-switch"><a href="../burden/index.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">View the CVD events dashboard →</a></div>
    <section class="bnr-data-display-card">
      <h3>Latest Data Release</h3>
      <table class="bnr-metadata-table"><tbody>${metaRows.map(d => html`<tr><td>${d.item}</td><td>${d.value}</td></tr>`)}</tbody></table>
      <h3 style="margin-top:1rem">Mortality definitions</h3>
      <p><strong>Primary</strong> includes deaths classified as clear or likely CVD. <strong>Inclusive</strong> also includes possible CVD deaths. These BNR categories are designed for registry reporting and are not necessarily the same as official international ICD-10 mortality statistics.</p>
      <p><strong>How deaths are classified:</strong> <a href="../../../../methods/interpretation/classifying-cvd-deaths.html">Read how BNR decides whether a death is classified as CVD, and what Primary and Inclusive mean.</a></p>
      <p>A dash or asterisk does not mean zero. It means that the value is protected and is not shown. The dashboard does not try to infer or reconstruct protected values.</p>
      <h3 style="margin-top:1rem">Downloads</h3>
      <table class="bnr-download-table"><thead><tr><th>Resource</th><th>Description</th><th>Link</th></tr></thead><tbody>
        <tr><td>Current CSV</td><td>Current published mortality dataset in CSV format.</td><td><a href="../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv" download>Download CSV</a></td></tr>
        <tr><td>Monthly reference CSV</td><td>Fixed 2015–2019 monthly historical reference.</td><td><a href="../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv" download>Download reference CSV</a></td></tr>
        <tr><td>Dataset information</td><td>Definitions and technical details for the current mortality dataset.</td><td><a href="../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/metadata/mort_burden_metrics_current.yml" download>Download metadata</a></td></tr>
        <tr><td>Reference information</td><td>Definitions and technical details for the monthly historical reference.</td><td><a href="../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/metadata/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.yml" download>Download metadata</a></td></tr>
        <tr><td>Release package</td><td>Complete public files for this release.</td><td>${zipName ? html`<a href=${`../../../../downloads/files/metrics/mortality/burden/${zipName}`} download>Download ZIP</a>` : "—"}</td></tr>
      </tbody></table>
    </section>

    <section class="bnr-data-display-card">
      <div class="bnr-data-title">Data shown for the selected view</div>
      <div class="bnr-data-tabs">
        <span class="bnr-data-tab bnr-data-tab-active">Table</span>
        <a class="bnr-data-tab bnr-data-tab-download" href=${selectedViewUrl} download=${selectedViewFilename}>Download selected view (CSV)</a>
      </div>
      <p class="bnr-trend-note"><strong>Rows shown:</strong> ${displayRows.length.toLocaleString()}. The selected-view download contains the same rows and displayed values as this table. Protected values stay protected.</p>

        <tbody>${displayRows
          .map(d => html`<tr class=${isComplete(d) ? "" : "bnr-incomplete-row"}>
            <td>${periodLabel(d)}</td>
            <td>${definitionText(d)}</td>

            <td>${sexLabel(d.sex) || d.sex}</td>

            <td>${statisticLabel(d)}</td>
            <td class=${isSafe(d) ? "" : "bnr-suppressed"}>${displayText(d)}</td>
            <td>${d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" ? rateInterval(d) : ""}</td>
            <td>${d.metric_id === "MORT-RATE-001" ? ciMethodLabel(d.ci_method) : ""}</td>
            <td>${isComplete(d) ? "Complete" : "Incomplete"}</td>
            <td>${d.disclosure_note || ""}</td>
          </tr>`)}
        </tbody>
      </table></div>
    </section>
  </div>`
}
```
